 Will the PlayStation Portal be any cheaper during the 2026 Black Friday sales? 
 ❚ We may earn commission from links on this page. Our editorial is always independent ( learn more ). Will the PlayStation Portal be any cheaper during the 2026 Black Friday sales?
 Black Friday is almost here, and PlayStation Portal gamers are in for a treat. 
 Currys Joanna Magill 
 Published: Friday, 13 November 2026 at 4:22 pm Share on facebook 
 Share on twitter 
 Share on pinterest 
 Share on reddit 
 Email to a friend 
 If you've had your eye on the PlayStation Portal, right now could be the best time to snap it up.
 Ad Last year's Black Friday sales saw discounts of £20 available on PlayStation's handheld gaming device. But with another year under its belt, we're expecting higher discounts on the console during the 2026 Black Friday sales.
 The PlayStation Portal is still at full price at major retailers like PlayStation, Very and Argos, but we have found some early Black Friday deals to help you start saving.
 Despite being released three years ago, the PlayStation Portal has jumped back to the forefront of public conversation as PlayStation has announced a new version going live next month— but only in Japan.
 This upcoming model boasts internal storage (the lack of which was a major issue for Portal users), comes with a free one-month PlayStation Plus Premium subscription and doesn't require gamers to already own a PS5. These major improvements don't seem to have too much bearing on the price point, which is coming in at 40,000 yen or roughly $253USD.
 It hasn't yet been announced when this model will be released in the UK, or in any markets other than Japan.
 Buy PlayStation Portal for £219.99 £205 (save £14.99 or 7%) at EE 
 For more on PlayStation this Black Friday, check out our guides to the new GTA 6 controller and will the PS5 Pro be discounted this Black Friday ?

 Should I wait for PlayStation Portal Black Friday deals? 
 Historically, the best Black Friday discounts were saved for the last weekend in November, just after Thanksgiving.
 However, as Black Friday has now changed from a single shopping weekend into a month-long shopping event, there's no guarantee that the best deals will arrive on 27 November 2026.
 With that in mind, if you spot a particularly good deal on the PlayStation Portal, it might be worth snapping it up now rather than waiting for Black Friday itself.
 Buy PlayStation Portal for £219.99 £205 (save £14.99 or 7%) at EE 
 Best PlayStation Portal Black Friday deal in the UK today 
 Save £14.99 on PS Portal at EE 
 PlayStation Portal  EE EE are currently offering the PlayStation Portal for £205, £14.99 than its usual price of £219.99.
 You can also bundle it with other PlayStation items, including the DualSense Wireless Controller or a £50 PlayStation Store gift card, for additional savings.
 According to the EE website, this offer is live until 11:59pm on 30 November.
 Buy PlayStation Portal for £219.99 £205 (save £14.99 or 7%) at EE 
 Are there any other PlayStation Portal Black Friday deals live today? 
 PlayStation Portal, Gift Card & HYPERX Cloud II Pro 7.1 Gaming Headset Bundle 
 PlayStation Portal, Gift Card & HYPERX Cloud II Pro 7.1 Gaming Headset bundle  Currys This bumper package from Currys includes the PlayStation Portal console, along with a £20 PlayStation Store gift card and the HYPERX Cloud II Pro 7.1 Gaming Headset Bundle.
 Bought separately, these items come to £279.98, meaning that this bundle gets you a saving of almost £40.
 Buy PlayStation Portal, Gift Card & HYPERX Cloud II Pro 7.1 Gaming Headset Bundle for £279.98 £249 (save £39.98 or 14%) at Currys 
 Frasers Plus members save £20 on the PlayStation Portal 
 UK websites including GAME and Sports Direct are offering a special Frasers Plus Price for Frasers Plus members, taking the price of the PlayStation Portal from £219.99 to £199.99.
 You can become a Frasers Plus members through the application portal online . You must be over 18 and have an annual income of over £7,500 to join.
 This reduced price is marked as an 'Early Bird Discount', leading us to believe that this discount will eventually be available to non-Frasers Plus members, or perhaps lead to further reductions in price.
 Save £20 on the PlayStation Portal at GAME 
 Save £20 on the PlayStation Portal at Sports Direct 
 Save £59 for opting for a refurbished model 
 One of the best way to save money on any piece of tech is to opt for a refurbished model. You can currently find a refurbished PlayStation Portal for just £160.99 at BackMarket.
 When it comes to sites like BackMarket, refurbished has a very different definition to second-hand. According to the website, "The sellers we partner with are held to rigorous quality guidelines that ensure every item we sell runs like new.
 "The refurbishment process includes meticulously cleaning, testing, and assessing every item, as well as replacing aging parts with high-quality new components."
 Buy refurbished PlayStation Portal for £219.99 £160.99 (save £59 or 27%) at BackMarket 
 While there may not be many PlayStation Portal Black Friday deals currently live, we'll be sure to keep this page updated with the latest deals available in the UK . 
 Where else can you buy the PlayStation Portal in the UK? 
 In addition to those already mentioned, the PlayStation Portal is available at a wide range of UK retailers. Here's where you can find the PlayStation Portal in the UK, currently at full price:
